warning: Este inventario sale del SQL versionado. No es el esquema real de un entorno hasta cruzarlo con un catálogo observado.

objects.name: account_deletion_audit
objects.purpose: Deletion audit. Retained. Not PII beyond user id.

objects.name: affiliate_commission_revisions
objects.purpose: Append-only commission amount history. Never UPDATE gross_commission_cents silently. No ledger mutation.

objects.name: affiliate_commissions
objects.purpose: Commission Foundation: importe confirmado/reportado por red. No liquida dinero. ledger_entry_id null hasta settlement.

objects.name: affiliate_conversions
objects.purpose: Conversion Foundation: eventos de conversión de red. Nunca inventados desde clicks. No liquida dinero.

objects.name: affiliate_economic_events
objects.purpose: Audit append-only de conversion/commission. Sin PII. Sin secretos.

objects.name: affiliate_import_batches
objects.purpose: Auditoría de importación de evidencia de afiliados. No es un segundo ledger.

objects.name: affiliate_ledger_entries
objects.purpose: Comisiones de afiliado de plataforma (AVENTA): import manual o futura automatización; no confundir con reparto a creadores.

objects.name: affiliate_reconciliation_findings
objects.purpose: Per-entity reconciliation outcomes. Informational only — never settles money.

objects.name: affiliate_reconciliation_runs
objects.purpose: Reconciliation foundation: network snapshot vs internal economic truth. Does not mutate money.

objects.name: announcements
objects.purpose: Avisos del sitio (ej. Descubre AVENTA, activa correos). Solo activos visibles en la campana.

objects.name: app_config
objects.purpose: Configuración de la app (ej. show_tester_offers para ofertas de ejemplo en home).

objects.name: caza_affiliate_mappings
objects.purpose: CazaOfertasss FASE 4.1 — operated affiliate mappings. identity_key == DealIdentity.key. No secrets. Independent of Aventa money path.

objects.name: caza_affiliate_mappings_touch_updated_at_trg
objects.purpose: Asociado a caza_affiliate_mappings

objects.name: caza_deal_candidates
objects.purpose: CazaOfertasss FASE 1 — DealCandidate persistence. Independent of Aventa money path.

objects.name: caza_publications
objects.purpose: CazaOfertasss FASE 1 — publication tracking. Idempotent on publication_id. No Telegram send.

objects.name: caza_revenue_attributions
objects.purpose: CazaOfertasss FASE 3 — attribution decisions. SEPARATE from financial events. UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN.

objects.name: caza_revenue_events
objects.purpose: CazaOfertasss FASE 1 — affiliate revenue ledger. APPEND-ONLY. Server-only. Not Aventa money path.

objects.name: caza_revenue_import_batches
objects.purpose: CazaOfertasss FASE 3 — import batch metadata. APPEND-ONLY. Not Aventa money path.

objects.name: caza_revenue_raw_records
objects.purpose: CazaOfertasss FASE 3 — raw revenue records as ingested. APPEND-ONLY. Opaque payload_json.

objects.name: commission_allocations
objects.purpose: Monto asignado por usuario en un pool mensual (pendiente, pagado o void).

objects.name: commission_pools
objects.purpose: Snapshot mensual del reparto para creadores: ingresos de afiliado, % para creadores y totales.

objects.name: coupon_interactions
objects.purpose: Copy, view and outbound are separate events. A click is not a conversion. No PII.

objects.name: coupons
objects.purpose: Canonical coupon. offers.coupons stays the free-text note. This table is the intelligence record. Expiration does not delete history.

objects.name: creator_rewards
objects.purpose: Recompensas V1: parte de comisión atribuida al creador de la oferta.

objects.name: deal_alert_subscriptions
objects.purpose: S6.4 Deal Alerts subscription source of truth. No delivery status. No money fields.

objects.name: discovery_cycle_snapshots
objects.purpose: Day 8 durable VERIFIED-yield funnel per continuous discovery cycle. Service role only.

objects.name: distribution_brands
objects.purpose: Distribution brand umbrella. One brand → N destinations. Never clones offers.

objects.name: distribution_destinations
objects.purpose: External distribution surfaces. Provider-agnostic; Telegram adapter comes later.

objects.name: distribution_events
objects.purpose: Append-only distribution lifecycle events. Not attribution. Not offer_events. No fake views/clicks/conversions.

objects.name: distribution_publications
objects.purpose: Fan-out work items: one row per offer×destination×version. Never clones offers. Not conversions.

objects.name: economic_order_reconciliation_candidates
objects.purpose: Candidato de reconciliación. No fusiona conversiones ni impide ingestas distintas. Sin clave explícita no hay fila.

objects.name: economic_shadow_projections
objects.purpose: NON_WITHDRAWABLE. SHADOW_ONLY. Observación reproducible de una comisión. No es saldo, no es ledger y no puede convertirse en payout.

objects.name: enforce_display_name_change_limit_trigger
objects.purpose: Asociado a profiles

objects.name: hunter_candidate_human_labels
objects.purpose: Human review labels over Hunter candidates for false-negative/positive dataset. Append-friendly.

objects.name: hunter_discovery_events
objects.purpose: Discovery Experiment v1: append-only sightings. Shadow only — never publication.

objects.name: hunter_discovery_scheduler_state
objects.purpose: Adaptive discovery cursors. Observation scheduling only. Never mint.

objects.name: hunter_intelligence_runs
objects.purpose: Hunter Run Report aggregates for Candidate Intelligence. Observation mode default.

objects.name: hunter_offer_candidates
objects.purpose: Candidate Intelligence ledger: every analyzed Hunter candidate with disposition. Shadow/observation — not publication.

objects.name: hunter_shadow_cycles
objects.purpose: Snapshot agregado por ciclo del Autonomous Decision Engine en modo shadow. Append-only, sin PII ni URLs.

objects.name: hunter_shadow_outcomes
objects.purpose: Correlación append-only Autonomous Shadow vs human outcome. moderation_logs sigue siendo la fuente de la acción humana. Sin PII extra ni payloads.

objects.name: hunter_source_health
objects.purpose: Salud y circuit breaker del Hunter Engine por fuente. Sin secretos.

objects.name: hunter_supply_runs
objects.purpose: Snapshots append-only de supply por corrida/source. Verified deal contribution, no raw candidate count. Sin PII ni URLs.

objects.name: ingest_cycle_locks
objects.purpose: Lock distribuido con TTL para ciclos de ingest. Evita trabajo duplicado entre isolates; no es un control de seguridad.

objects.name: intelligence_shadow_decisions
objects.purpose: What intelligence would have done. Stage cannot be canary or enabled. Production state is not mutated.

objects.name: ledger_settlements
objects.purpose: P0-4: claim 1:1 de liquidación pagable por ledger. Canal único: creator_reward.

objects.name: machine_client_calls
objects.purpose: Auditoría append-only de llamadas MCP. Sin secretos ni payload. Nunca se actualiza ni borra.

objects.name: machine_client_calls_no_truncate
objects.purpose: Asociado a machine_client_calls

objects.name: machine_client_calls_no_update
objects.purpose: Asociado a machine_client_calls

objects.name: machine_clients
objects.purpose: Clientes máquina MCP (proveedores de candidatos). Token: sólo prefijo + SHA-256. Sin DELETE; revocar es permanente.

objects.name: machine_clients_guard_delete
objects.purpose: Asociado a machine_clients

objects.name: machine_clients_guard_truncate
objects.purpose: Asociado a machine_clients

objects.name: machine_clients_guard_update
objects.purpose: Asociado a machine_clients

objects.name: mercadolibre_oauth_tokens
objects.purpose: Conexión OAuth Mercado Libre de plataforma Aventa. Una fila; acceso exclusivo service_role.

objects.name: moderation_outcomes
objects.purpose: Append-only human moderation outcomes (claim/approve/reject/snooze). Observability only; never drives auto-approve.

objects.name: notifications
objects.purpose: Notificaciones in-app (campana): oferta aprobada, comentario, destacada, etc.

objects.name: offer_batch_item_events
objects.purpose: Auditoría append-only de acciones sobre lotes/ítems. Nunca se actualiza ni borra.

objects.name: offer_batch_items
objects.purpose: Ítem de lote. APPROVED = oferta pending creada (offer_id). PUBLISHED se deriva de offers.status=approved.

objects.name: offer_batches
objects.purpose: Lotes de URLs pegadas por staff. Contadores se recalculan en servidor tras cada mutación.

objects.name: offer_health_state
objects.purpose: Último resultado de verificación en tienda (precio/agotado). Actualizado por cron offer-health-scan.

objects.name: offer_lifecycle_runs
objects.purpose: Offers lifecycle v2 run log. Written only by maintenance.run_offers_lifecycle.

objects.name: offer_observations
objects.purpose: Append-only product observation for ingestion. Does not replace offers columns. Replay uses idempotency_key.

objects.name: offer_votes_reputation_weighted_trigger
objects.purpose: Asociado a offer_votes

objects.name: offers
objects.purpose: W1 canonical offers (uuid). Legacy demo rows remain in public.ofertas; view offers_legacy_compat_v. No automatic data copy.

objects.name: payout_batch_lines
objects.purpose: Líneas por creador con decisión de gates (pass/review/fail/carry) y resultado de liberación.

objects.name: payout_batches
objects.purpose: Centro de Pagos V3: foto aprobada de quién cobra en un periodo. No mueve dinero; la salida es payout_intents.

objects.name: payout_intents
objects.purpose: M4.1: claim 1:1 de intención de payout por creator_reward. Authority separada de reward_payouts legacy.

objects.name: plaza_discussions
objects.purpose: Conversaciones de la Plaza Aventa.

objects.name: plaza_requests
objects.purpose: Solicitudes de ofertas de la Plaza Aventa.

objects.name: price_intelligence_rollups
objects.purpose: Derived price knowledge. Raw rows stay in product_price_snapshots and offer_price_snapshots. Offer raw retention target is 180 days after a rollup exists. Product daily rows are kept. Not applied automatically.

objects.name: reward_audit_log
objects.purpose: Auditoría de acciones del Programa de Recompensas.

objects.name: reward_clawback_adjustments
objects.purpose: Ajuste/clawback pendiente sobre recompensa PAID. El reward permanece PAID; no se revierte silenciosamente.

objects.name: reward_payouts
objects.purpose: Pagos SPEI manuales de recompensas AVAILABLE.
